source: Federal Reserve Board H.10 release XML <https://www.federalreserve.gov/releases/h10/data/FRB_h10_xml.zip>, H10_data.xml, series JRXWTFB_N.B, JRXWTFN_N.B, JRXWTFO_N.B
notes: Federal Reserve Board H.10 release XML (FRB_h10_xml.zip), the three daily nominal dollar indexes (broad, AFE, EME), long format, one row per series per date with status A; ND (no data, value -9999) rows are kept in interim and listed in the run log, not in processed. Unit code as returned (Index:_1997_Jan_100, although the Technical Q&As give a January 2006 base). Effective 2019-06-24 the Board changed the indexation of the daily broad, AFE and EME indexes (H.10 Technical Q&As). The Board overwrites the zip at each release and keeps no archive, and revises past values when trade weights change, so each run's zip is kept (append_only_snapshot) and revisions against the previous run are warned; history before our first run is the latest vintage. Not the Data Download Program and not FRED (Proposed ADR-0006). Public domain unless otherwise indicated; cite the Board. published_at = the Monday after the observation's week + 2 days 23:59:59 Asia/Karachi in UTC (basis h10_following_monday_plus_2d).
